items.imgPrompt: A sleek black Smeg stand mixer, sitting on a dark walnut kitchen island, pristine condition, modern minimalist kitchen background, natural lighting.

name.zh: Smeg 廚師機/和麵機 (黑色)
name.zh_cn: Smeg 厨师机/和面机 (黑色)

desc.zh: 買來原本想給家裡的小祖宗做手工意面，後來發現我還是更擅長看合同。用了兩次，全砸了。隨便出，騰地方放她的零食櫃。
desc.zh_cn: 买来原本想给家里的小祖宗做手工意面，后来发现我还是更擅长看合同。用了两次，全砸了。随便出，腾地方放她的零食柜。
desc.en: Bought this thinking I could make handmade pasta for the little ancestor at home, but realized I'm much better at reading contracts. Used twice, total disaster. Selling cheap to make room for her snack cabinet.

items.imgPrompt: A luxury mechanical watch with a dark leather strap, resting in its open velvet presentation box on a dark grey marble table, unworn.

name.zh: 全新 某牌複雜功能機械錶
name.zh_cn: 全新 某牌复杂功能机械表

desc.zh: 客戶贏了對賭協議硬塞的謝禮。我不戴機械錶，抱小孩的時候容易硌到她。全新未戴過，隨便掛個價，懂行的自己拍。
desc.zh_cn: 客户赢了对赌协议硬塞的谢礼。我不戴机械表，抱小孩的时候容易硌到她。全新未戴过，随便挂个价，懂行的自己拍。
desc.en: A thank-you gift a client forced on me after winning a VAM dispute. I don't wear mechanical watches, the metal scratches the kid when I hold her. Brand new, priced whatever, buy if you know the market.

items.imgPrompt: A black leather Cassina LC2 armchair with chrome steel frame, sitting on a grey carpet in a dimly lit study, excellent condition.

name.zh: Cassina LC2 黑色真皮單人沙發
name.zh_cn: Cassina LC2 黑色真皮单人沙发

desc.zh: 意式極簡單人沙發。原本放在書房，現在太佔地方了，得空出一半空間給她放那些漫畫書和盲盒。95新，限上海自提。
desc.zh_cn: 意式极简单人沙发。原本放在书房，现在太占地方了，得空出一半空间给她放那些漫画书和盲盒。95新，限上海自提。
desc.en: Italian minimalist armchair. Used to be in my study, but it takes up too much space now. Need to clear half the room for her manga and blind boxes. 95% new, pickup in Shanghai only.

items.imgPrompt: An unopened square glass perfume bottle with a gold label, sitting on a dark wooden console table, still in its original cellophane wrapping.

name.zh: 某品牌女士香水 (全新未拆)
name.zh_cn: 某品牌女士香水 (全新未拆)

desc.zh: 某位自作聰明的女士故意落在副駕駛的。全新未拆。趕緊出掉，免得家裡那個嬌氣包聞到了跟我鬧脾氣。
desc.zh_cn: 某位自作聪明的女士故意落在副驾驶的。全新未拆。赶紧出掉，免得家里那个娇气包闻到了跟我闹脾气。
desc.en: Left in my passenger seat by some woman trying to be clever. Brand new, sealed. Getting rid of it quickly before the spoiled brat at home smells it and throws a tantrum.

items.imgPrompt: A heavily tarnished custom solid silver Zippo lighter, resting on a dark mahogany desk, next to a crystal ashtray, moody lighting, visible scratches and patina.

desc.zh: 找某個小騙子的那幾年抽煙抽得兇，用舊了。現在人逮到了，準備戒煙，隨便出。別問，問就是家裡那位要管我了。
desc.zh_cn: 找某个小骗子的那几年抽烟抽得凶，用旧了。现在人逮到了，准备戒烟，随便出。别问，问就是家里那位要管我了。
desc.en: Smoked too much during the years I was looking for a certain little liar, so it's worn out. Now that I've caught them, I'm quitting smoking. Selling cheap. Don't ask, my baby is going to keep me in check now.

items.imgPrompt: A large, pristine vintage Steiff teddy bear with a silk ribbon, sitting on a luxurious dark leather sofa, tags still attached, natural window light.

desc.zh: 幾年前買給某個沒良心的小孩的。佔地方，看著就來氣。現在小孩長大了，不需要這種哄人的玩意兒了，直接帶走。
desc.zh_cn: 几年前买给某个没良心的小孩的。占地方，看着就来气。现在小孩长大了，不需要这种哄人的玩意儿了，直接带走。
desc.en: Bought this years ago for a heartless kid. Takes up space and pisses me off just looking at it. The kid is all grown up now and doesn't need this kind of coaxing toy anymore. Just take it.

items.imgPrompt: A pristine, unused white handheld gaming console in its original opened box, sitting on a sleek marble countertop, dust-free.

name.en: Brand New Handheld Console Gathering Dust

desc.zh: 當年以為網戀對象是個愛打遊戲的未成年，特意買的。結果人跑了，一次沒送出去。放著落灰，當垃圾處理了。
desc.zh_cn: 当年以为网恋对象是个爱打游戏的未成年，特意买的。结果人跑了，一次没送出去。放着落灰，当垃圾处理了。
desc.en: Bought this back then thinking my online date was an underage kid who loved games. They ran away, so I never got to give it. Gathering dust, treating it as trash.

items.imgPrompt: A classic black quilted designer mini flap bag with gold hardware, sitting on a velvet chair, still in its dust bag, flawless condition.

desc.zh: 原本打算送她的成年禮物，遲到了好幾年。款式老了，配不上我的乖乖，隨便賣了，今晚帶她去專櫃挑新的。
desc.zh_cn: 原本打算送她的成年礼物，迟到了好几年。款式老了，配不上我的乖乖，随便卖了，今晚带她去专柜挑新的。
desc.en: Was supposed to be her coming-of-age gift, delayed by a few years. The style is too old now, not good enough for my good girl. Selling it for whatever, taking her to the boutique to pick new ones tonight.
